scope: Saved-page local business extraction followed by semantic evidence-ID selection; unchanged application validators. No live retrieval/native Firecrawl comparison.

dataset.review: Agent-authored and independently source-reviewed by another agent before V4 inference; no external human annotation.
dataset.v6_curriculum_source: Original V4 140-row parent, with paired business projections/aliases; not the V5 token-filtered curriculum.

exception.change: Only two environment-variable mappings were added to Settings.from_env; their target fields and defaults already existed.
exception.allowlist_scope: Exact old/new config hashes and sole changed application path; no general exemption for config or production changes.

selection.checkpoint_policy: One preregistered final checkpoint per run; no checkpoint search.
selection.final_site_test_policy: Only the base and frozen V6 candidate generate site-test outputs, once after validation; no post-test tuning.

metric_definitions.raw_business: Unmodified stage-one JSON, including records rejected by grounding.
metric_definitions.accepted: Passes the complete application gate; acceptance is not proof of semantic truth.
metric_definitions.exact_record: Complete typed business object exactly matches gold, including keys and nulls.
metric_definitions.source_valid: Literal/reference mechanics, not arbitrary field meaning.
metric_definitions.anchor_agreement: Preferred reviewed-anchor agreement is a proxy; another anchor can be valid.
metric_definitions.denominators: All original cases/full-page facts retained through omissions and failures.
metric_definitions.latency: Includes failures and warm-up; not accepted-correct throughput.

limitations: Small English technical-documentation-heavy flat custom-schema pilot; final site test has eight pages/four reserved families.
Validation informed V5 and V6 design; validation is selection data, not a fresh generalization estimate.
V6 changed supervision balance, training duration and learning rate together; this is not a causal ablation of row balance.
Raw sources/completions stay private; exact historical reproduction requires the reviewed corpus and pinned serving artifacts.
No matched benchmark against Firecrawl native extraction or hosted extraction models establishes competitive superiority.
Actual networkless preparation does not establish live Studio scraping or full API retrieval.
Studio VPN/blocked egress and existing defaults remain unchanged; no paid inference calls were used.
